title: 의견 카드가 다른 카드와 구별되지 않는다
reason: The 의견 start card is visually identical to the five question cards, yet it is a statement sent in the reader's own voice that writes a real row to the operator review queue. The first-person sentence is the only consent signal.
dropped_reason: Superseded by P11.F1: the 의견 card is removed from the start screen at the operator's gate rejection, so a card that files a row in the reader's name no longer exists to be indistinguishable from the others.
